iphone-duo.tagline: The first foldable iPhone. Two displays, one simple gesture.
description: iPhone Duo unfolds into a 7.6" inner display with no visible crease and folds into a 5.4" iPhone that fits in any pocket. The titanium design is just 5.2 mm thin when open.
The A20 Pro chip, the 48 MP camera system and all-day battery life make Duo a complete phone — and a tablet whenever you need one.
highlights: Touch ID in the side button

rows.v: A20 Pro — 6-core CPU, 7-core GPU, dual 16-core Neural Engine
Dual-cell, up to 24 hours of typical use
Touch ID in the side button

iphone-18-pro.tagline: Pro in every detail. A camera with variable aperture.
description: iPhone 18 Pro brings the A20 Pro chip, a 6.3" ProMotion display with up to 3000 nits outdoors and a triple 48 MP camera system with variable aperture on the main camera.
The Apple C2 modem, Wi‑Fi 7 and an aluminium unibody with Ceramic Shield 2 make it faster, tougher and more efficient than ever. Battery life reaches up to 36 hours of video playback.

rows.v: ProMotion up to 120 Hz, Always‑On, 3000 nits outdoors

iphone-18-pro-max.tagline: The biggest display and the longest battery life ever in an iPhone Pro.
description: iPhone 18 Pro Max brings the A20 Pro chip, a 6.9" ProMotion display with up to 3000 nits outdoors and a triple 48 MP camera system with variable aperture on the main camera.
The Apple C2 modem, Wi‑Fi 7 and an aluminium unibody with Ceramic Shield 2 make it faster, tougher and more efficient than ever. Battery life reaches up to 45 hours of video playback.

rows.v: ProMotion up to 120 Hz, Always‑On, 3000 nits outdoors

iphone-air.tagline: The thinnest iPhone ever. Incredibly light, surprisingly powerful.
description: iPhone Air is just 5.6 mm thin, with a titanium frame, a 6.5" ProMotion display and the A19 Pro chip.
A 48 MP Fusion camera, the Apple C1X modem and Ceramic Shield 2 on both sides — all in an iPhone you'll barely feel in your pocket.

rows.v: 6.5" Super Retina XDR, ProMotion 120 Hz, Always‑On

iphone-17.tagline: ProMotion display, Center Stage front camera and 256 GB as standard.
description: iPhone 17 comes with a 6.3" ProMotion Always‑On display, the A19 chip and a dual 48 MP camera system.
The 18 MP Center Stage front camera and Ceramic Shield 2, with three times better scratch resistance, round off the most balanced iPhone in the line-up.

iphone-17e.tagline: Everything that matters in an iPhone, at the best price.
description: iPhone 17e brings the A19 chip, the Apple C1X modem and MagSafe to a 6.1" design — now with 256 GB of base storage.
The 48 MP Fusion camera takes excellent photos day and night, and the battery easily lasts until evening.

iphone-16.tagline: Camera Control, Apple Intelligence and the A18 chip.
description: iPhone 16 has the Camera Control button, the A18 chip and a 48 MP Fusion camera — an excellent choice at a reduced price.
The Action button, USB‑C and up to 22 hours of video playback still make it a complete iPhone today.

macbook-neo.tagline: Your first Mac. In four cheerful colours.
description: MacBook Neo is Apple's most affordable laptop: a 13" Liquid Retina display, the A18 Pro chip and up to 16 hours of battery life, in a 1.23 kg aluminium enclosure.
Perfect for school, university and everything you do every day — with macOS, iCloud and seamless iPhone integration.

description: MacBook Air 13" with the M5 chip is fast at everything — from presentations to photo editing — and completely silent, with no fan.
Up to 18 hours of battery life, Wi‑Fi 7, a 12 MP Center Stage camera and a keyboard with the Romanian layout.

description: Studio Display XDR delivers extreme contrast and HDR brightness for video grading and professional photography.
Factory calibration, reference modes and a Thunderbolt 5 connection.

ipad-a16.tagline: The colourful iPad for the whole family.

ipad-mini.tagline: All of iPad, in one hand.

apple-watch-series-12.tagline: Brighter, smarter, with new health sensors.

Satellite communication, dual-frequency GPS, recreational diving to 40 m and built-in 5G.

description: AirPods Pro 3 have next-generation Active Noise Cancellation, a heart-rate sensor for workouts and Live Translation.

apple-tv-4k.tagline: 4K HDR films, Dolby Atmos and the heart of your smart home.

homepod.tagline: Spatial sound that fills the room.
description: HomePod delivers high-fidelity audio, with a high-excursion woofer and five tweeters, automatically tuned to your room.

homepod-mini.tagline: Surprisingly big sound, in five colours.
